Solubility.justification: Consensus improves RMSE (0.84 to 0.79) and MAE (0.68 to 0.62) with reliable uncertainty calibration from model disagreement.

Permeability.justification: Admetica Chemprop performs adequately (MAE 0.38, R2 0.38); consensus maintains stability without significant gain. Keep shadow mode.

CYP3A4 inhibitor.justification: Consensus improves Balanced Accuracy (0.610 to 0.635) and AUROC (0.653 to 0.678) while reducing Brier score (0.218 to 0.198).

hERG liability.justification: High false-positive rate on held-out ChEMBL set requires shadow mode retention until experimental patch-clamp calibration.

Metabolic soft spots.justification: Rank fusion architecture verified; proceed to prospective evaluation in Stage 4D-2B.
